notes.title: " GAME COMPANY SIMULATOR: BACK TO 2000" Update log
notes.content:
Hello bosses!

Thank you for your support and feedback on " GAME COMPANY SIMULATOR: BACK TO 2000"！
Today’s update is here! Although the members of the studio are very busy, but seeing everyone having fun in the game, we think it is worth!

This update is mainly for bug fixes and experience optimization:

·Bug fix
- Fixed the bug that the lower left corner shows an error “7777” due to the dismissal of the employee. 
- Fixed the bug of not being able to get a sense of belonging by skipping recruitment.

·optimization
- Optimized the display of the amount of furniture, themes and other items.
- Optimized the numerical system of "employee motivation" function.

·New features
- Choosing n+1 or 2n when dismissing employees will make other employees feel that the boss is very conscientious, so the sense of belonging will increase.
- Press the "+" key on the small keyboard to double the speed (the original speed will be restored when entering the exhibition, please accelerate after the employees to return to their positions to prevent errors).

You can get a better game experience by updating, thank you again for your support! Welcome to join our official QQ group for more information and feedback: 1005661002.

notes.title: " GAME COMPANY SIMULATOR: BACK TO 2000" Update log
notes.content:
Hello bosses!

Thank you for your support and feedback on " GAME COMPANY SIMULATOR: BACK TO 2000" since its release. We received a lot of feedback, and we have been fixing bugs and optimizing the game day and night. Although there were many difficulties, you still gave us a lot of encouragement, which enabled us to move forward. We will continue to work hard to bring you the best experience!

We have made a version update; this update is mainly for bug fixes and experience optimization:

·Bug fix
- Fixed the bug that some rooms could not clear the negative status of employees correctly
- Fixed the bug that the employee information bar was not displayed properly

·optimization
- Optimized the CPU usage of the game
- In-game font size adjustment
- Logical adjustment of the number of fans
- Logic adjustment of dream income
- Employees will now call "Boss" according to the player's settings

We noticed that high CPU usage is a problem that players are very concerned about. However, due to time constraints, the optimization of the CPU usage is not very obvious this time, but we are still continuing to optimize!

Welcome to join our official QQ group for more information and feedback: 1005661002.
